description: This file contains logic for determining when to skip autocomplete suggestions based on the current editing context, including language-specific statement terminators and word boundaries.

classes.name: LanguageFamilyConfig
classes.description: Interface defining configuration for language families, including language IDs and statement terminators.

methods.name: getTerminatorsForLanguage
methods.description: Returns the list of statement terminators for a given language ID, or default terminators if none is specified.

methods.name: shouldSkipAutocomplete
methods.description: Determines whether autocomplete should be skipped based on cursor position and current input context.
